description_zh: 通过本接口，可以查询webCall通话记录信息
name: CloudQueryWebcallCdr

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: If the uniqueId value is not empty, all other parameters below are ignored, and only the record with the specified phone unique identifier (uniqueId) is queried
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: Queries the record corresponding to the unique request ID. By default, the current month is queried. If the requestUniqueId does not belong to the current month, pass the query parameter startTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The call result. Parameter description:
20: webCall, TTS synthesis failed.
21: webCall, customer did not answer.
22: webCall, customer answered.
23: webCall, called.
24: webCall, both parties answered
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明： 20 webcall, TTS合成失败； 21 webcall, 客户未接 ； 22:webcall, 客户接听； 23: webcall； 已呼叫； 24: webcall, 双方接听；
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province to which the customer phone number belongs. Leave empty to query all provinces. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city to which the customer phone number belongs. Leave empty to query all cities. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
The type that determines how the startTime and endTime range takes effect. This parameter takes effect only when both startTime and endTime are specified. Valid values:
1: call start time.
2: call end time.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The query start time in UNIX timestamp format, accurate to seconds. startTime and endTime cannot span across months. Default value: the first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The query end time in UNIX timestamp format, accurate to seconds. startTime and endTime cannot span across months. Default value: the last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The offset from which to start retrieving records. Must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of records to retrieve. Must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of the user-defined parameter for field-specific search. When this parameter is specified, userFieldValue must also be specified. Only one field can be queried. Fuzzy match is not supported. The custom field query condition is constructed as: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of the user-defined parameter for field-specific search. When this parameter is specified, userFieldKey must also be specified. Only one field can be queried. Fuzzy match is not supported. The custom field query condition is constructed as: {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The customer phone number
parameters.help_zh: 客户号码
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The agent ID
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The outbound call group to which the agent belongs. A single group number is 2 to 20 characters. Supports querying one or more agent IDs separated by commas, with a maximum of 10 at a time. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The agent phone number
parameters.help_zh: 座席号码
parameters.name: callee_number

parameters.help_en: The actual displayed number. When the AXB scenario is used for outbound calls, the actual displayed number is a virtual number
parameters.help_zh: 真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，真实外显号码为虚拟号
parameters.name: display_number

parameters.help_en: The actual displayed number on the second side
parameters.help_zh: 第二侧真实外显号码
parameters.name: callee_display_number

parameters.help_en: The displayed number (caller ID)
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The displayed number (caller ID) on the second side
parameters.help_zh: 第二侧外显号码
parameters.name: callee_clid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the total count. Valid values:
0: Do not return.
1: Return.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回总条数；取值说明：0: 不返回，1：返回，不传默认为1
parameters.name: return_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the call was answered by a real person. Valid values:
1: yes.
0: no
parameters.help_zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
parameters.name: is_real_answer

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

List.description_en: The array of webcall call records

AnswerTime.description_en: The time when the system answers the call. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
AnswerTime.description_zh: 系统接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
AnswerTime.title_zh: 系统接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

BridgeDuration.description_en: The service processing duration, in seconds
BridgeDuration.description_zh: 服务处理时长秒数，单位是s
BridgeDuration.title_zh: 服务处理时长秒数，单位是s

BridgeTime.description_en: The time when the agent answered the call. This value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds, such as 1480904471
BridgeTime.description_zh: 座席接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
BridgeTime.title_zh: 座席接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

CallType.description_en: The call type. The value is webcall

CalleeClid.description_en: The displayed number (caller ID) on the second side

CalleeDisplayNumber.description_en: The actual displayed number on the second side

CalleeNumber.description_en: The agent phone number. The value is an area code followed by a 7-digit or 8-digit landline number without a hyphen (-) between them, or an 11-digit mobile number. Example: 0104100596
CalleeNumber.description_zh: 座席电话 区号 +7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。0104100596
CalleeNumber.title_zh: 座席电话 区号 +7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。0104100596

CalleeRingingTime.description_en: The time when the customer phone starts ringing. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
CalleeRingingTime.description_zh: 客户响铃时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
CalleeRingingTime.title_zh: 客户响铃时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

CustomerCity.description_en: The city to which the customer number belongs, such as Beijing
CustomerCity.description_zh: 客户号码归属城市,北京
CustomerCity.title_zh: 客户号码归属城市,北京

CustomerNumber.description_en: The customer number. A landline or mobile number in China. The format is area code + 7- or 8-digit landline number without a hyphen between the area code and the number, or an 11-digit mobile number. For example, 01041005968 or 18701051984. The format can also be virtual number-extension number, such as 18701051984-7538
CustomerNumber.description_zh: 客户号码 国内固话或手机，区号 + 7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。如 01041005968或18701051984 或虚拟号-分机号场景格式，如 18701051984-7538
CustomerNumber.title_zh: 客户号码 国内固话或手机，区号 + 7或8位的固话号码，区号与固话号码之间无'-'；或11位长度的手机号码。如 01041005968或18701051984 或虚拟号-分机号场景格式，如 18701051984-7538

CustomerProvince.description_en: The province to which the customer number belongs, such as Beijing
CustomerProvince.description_zh: 客户号码归属省份，如 北京
CustomerProvince.title_zh: 客户号码归属省份，如 北京

DetailRingingTime.description_en:
The time when the phone starts ringing after the call is transferred.

The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
DetailRingingTime.description_zh:
转话机后,话机响铃时间

使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
DetailRingingTime.title_zh: 转话机后,话机响铃时间

DisplayNumber.description_en: The actual displayed number. When the AXB scenario is used for outbound calls, the actual displayed number is a virtual number
DisplayNumber.description_zh: 真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，真实外显号码为虚拟号
DisplayNumber.title_zh: 真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，真实外显号码为虚拟号

DownGrade.description_en: Indicates whether the call is downgraded. Valid values: 0: Not downgraded. 1: Downgraded

DownGradeCounts.description_en: The number of call downgrade attempts

EndReason.description_en: The end reason. The hang-up reason after the call is answered. Valid values: 1000: The primary channel hangs up. 1001: A non-primary channel hangs up. 1002: The call is forcibly disconnected
EndReason.description_zh: 结束原因,接听之后的挂机原因 1000:主通道挂机 1001:非主通道挂机 1002:被强拆
EndReason.title_zh: 结束原因,接听之后的挂机原因 1000:主通道挂机 1001:非主通道挂机 1002:被强拆

EndTime.description_en: The time when the call ends. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
EndTime.description_zh: 电话结束时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
EndTime.title_zh: 电话结束时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Gno.description_en: The outbound call group number of the agent

IsRealAnswer.description_en: Indicates whether the call was answered by a real person. Valid values: 1: yes. 0: no. A null value indicates unknown
IsRealAnswer.description_zh: 是否真人接听：1 - 是、0 - 否、空值
IsRealAnswer.title_zh: 是否真人接听：1 - 是、0 - 否、空值

IvrName.description_en: The IVR name. The default value is custom

RealAnswerTime.description_en: The time when the call is answered by a person. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
RealAnswerTime.description_zh: 真人接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
RealAnswerTime.title_zh: 真人接听时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Monitor_type.description_en: The recording type. Valid values: 1: Mixed recording. 2: Separate-line recording (two mono WAV files are retained). 3: Voicemail. 5: Separate-line recording (one stereo WAV file is retained)
Monitor_type.description_zh: 混音 2. 分线录音（保留2个单声道WAV） 3.留言 5. 分线录音（保留1个双声道WAV）
Monitor_type.title_zh: 混音 2. 分线录音（保留2个单声道WAV） 3.留言 5. 分线录音（保留1个双声道WAV）

Type.description_en: The type. Valid values: record: a recording. voicemail: a voice mail
Type.description_zh: 取值：record,voicemail说明：record是录音， voicemail是留言
Type.title_zh: 取值：record,voicemail说明：record是录音， voicemail是留言

RequestUniqueId.description_zh: 用户自定义通话标识字段
RequestUniqueId.title_zh: 用户自定义通话标识字段

SipCause.description_zh: 号码状态识别编码，详见
SipCause.title_zh: 号码状态识别编码，详见

StartTime.description_en: The time when the call enters the system. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, such as 1480904471
StartTime.description_zh: 电话进入系统时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471
StartTime.title_zh: 电话进入系统时间，时间戳，精确到s，如1480904471

Status.description_en: The outbound call result, such as customer answered
Status.description_zh: 外呼结果， 如客户接听
Status.title_zh: 外呼结果， 如客户接听

StatusCode.description_en: The status code corresponding to the status

TotalDuration.description_en: The total call duration, in seconds
TotalDuration.description_zh: 总通话时长秒数，单位是s
TotalDuration.title_zh: 总通话时长秒数，单位是s
